title: Evidential Deep Learning with conditional entropy for glaucoma detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.13513v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a novel conditional entropy function as a basis for quantifying predictive uncertainty in Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) for glaucoma detection from retinal fundus images. Using the EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2 and RIM-ONE-DL datasets for validation, we found that our proposed EDL model regularized by conditional entropy function produced uncertainty estimates with substantially lower calibration errors than Deep Ensembles, MC Dropout, post-hoc calibration and the conventional EDL framework based on Dempster uncertainty. To further probe our models' interpretability, we analyzed Grad-CAM heatmaps using a focus index representing spatial concentration. Compared with the other uncertainty quantification methods, EDL models exhibited greater separation between the index distributions of correctly and incorrectly classified fundus images. translated_title: 基于条件熵的证据深度学习用于青光眼检测
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的条件熵函数，作为证据深度学习（EDL）中量化预测不确定性的基础，用于从视网膜眼底图像进行青光眼检测。使用EyePACS-AIROGS-light-V2和RIM-ONE-DL数据集进行验证，我们发现由条件熵函数正则化的EDL模型所产生的不确定性估计，其校准误差显著低于深度集成、MC Dropout、事后校准以及基于Dempster不确定性的传统EDL框架。为了进一步探究模型的可解释性，我们使用代表空间集中度的焦点指数分析了Grad-CAM热力图。与其他不确定性量化方法相比，EDL模型在正确分类和错误分类的眼底图像的焦点指数分布之间表现出更大的分离度。特别是，假阴性病例与局部化的Grad-CAM激活相关。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种由新型条件熵函数正则化的证据深度学习方法用于青光眼检测，其不确定性估计的校准误差显著优于深度集成、MC Dropout等传统方法，并通过Grad-CAM焦点指数分析提供了更好的可解释性。
